title: Broken-windows ledger
description: Cross-phase defect register accumulating stubs, TODOs, skipped tests, unrun verifies, and unmet truths into .planning/WINDOWS.md. When enforcement is enabled, it blocks /gsd-ship while any window is open unless explicitly waived with a recorded reason. Operationalizes GSD's no-defer discipline as a tracked artifact (issue #1950). Fork addition: the verifier's dead-code scan feeds this ledger as `lint-warning` entries instead of maintaining a parallel per-phase report.

workflow.windows_enforce.description: Enable the blocking ship:pre gate for the broken-windows ledger. When true (opt-in), /gsd-ship blocks while .planning/WINDOWS.md has any open entry. When false (default), windows are still tracked (the executor and verifier still populate WINDOWS.md via gsd-tools windows append) but ship does not block — teams can adopt tracking before enforcement. Issue #1950.

workflow.dead_code_scan.description: Scan phase-modified files for context pollution (commented-out code, dead feature flags, orphaned exports, parallel implementations) and record findings in the broken-windows ledger as lint-warning entries.
